about_the_game:
Every room is a life-or-death decision. You enter with nothing but a shuffled deck and your wits. Four random cards await—will you wield the diamond sword to face the spade monster? Heal with a precious heart potion? Or flee to fight another day? Navigate treacherous dungeons where every card in your deck must be used strategically to escape alive. This isn't about collecting the rarest cards; it's about making the most of what you have, turn by turn, in a relentless struggle for survival.

Your deck is your lifeline. Hearts heal, Diamonds are weapons, and Spades & Clubs are the monsters you must face or evade. The unique challenge? You must play every single card in your deck to escape. There are no shortcuts, just pure strategy, intense resource management, and nerve-wracking decisions.

Picaro is packed with features designed for endless replayability. Craft your perfect deck composition in the Custom Deck Builder and share it via the Steam Workshop. Compete for the fastest dungeon clears with a built-in speedrun timer. Analyze every decision with the comprehensive Replay System, and push your limits in procedurally generated endless dungeons. With full controller support, multiple difficulty settings, and a rich, adaptive soundtrack, Picaro offers a deep and addictive experience.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Debian + SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 400 / AMD Radeon HD 5000
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs through dedicated compatibility layer on Linux in default web browser, due to native webkit missing hardware acceleration.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Debian + SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Athlon X4
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 500 / AMD Radeon HD 6000
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs through dedicated compatibility layer on Linux in default web browser, due to native webkit missing hardware acceleration.
